messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Follow your diet, medication, and exercise routines very closely.
Store at room temperature away from moisture, heat, and light.
Triplet: ["Simvastatin", "is part of", "complete treatment program"]

The relation 'is part of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is a component of the treatment program or regimen specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'includes': The subject treatment program or regimen incorporates the component or element specified by the object entity.
B. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
D. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
E. 'are being treated with': The subject entity is receiving treatment with the substance or therapy specified by the object entity.
